{"artifact":"SmeDossierEnvelope","schema_version":"0.4.0","stage_id":"02.dossier_sections","probe":"rdmv-id-d","lineage":{"input_manifest_sha256":"0d9a260eb42430a13953354e43f19b2c3e4f1647582e4b3212c03f616080be01","candidate_lineage_id":"2026-10-28-rdmv-id-class-d:lineage:45","source_registry_sha256":"9c432577e712960022ff656d6738a091319c6e5e4dcbdcf9429cd450e142e543","source_liveness_sha256":"eee60602368bd429216c9c2833be0be6ed9e505e5c5accebaefb9d2b9a847475"},"envelope_scope":{"kind":"partial_chunk","assigned_section_ids":["C"],"chunk_index":1,"chunk_total":1},"section_char_limit":12000,"sections":[{"section_id":"C","chunk_id":"C.01","merge_seq":1,"domain":"Parking, backing and freeway driving","heading":"C — Parking, backing and freeway driving","learner_facing":true,"markdown":"## C — Parking, backing and freeway driving

FACT_ID: sec10-F01 | anchor: A81
When parking downhill, turn the front wheels sharply toward the curb or road edge to help prevent rolling into traffic. [A81]
Source: [A81 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0081]

FACT_ID: sec10-F02 | anchor: A81
When parking uphill with a curb, point the front wheels sharply away from the curb. [A81]
Source: [A81 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0081]

FACT_ID: sec10-F03 | anchor: A81
When parking uphill where there is no curb, turn the wheels sharply toward the road's edge. [A81]
Source: [A81 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0081]

FACT_ID: sec10-F04 | anchor: A81
Parking in a bicycle lane or on a sidewalk is prohibited. [A81]
Source: [A81 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0081]

FACT_ID: sec10-F05 | anchor: A81
Parking beside the street-facing side of another parked vehicle is prohibited double parking. [A81]
Source: [A81 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0081]

FACT_ID: sec10-F06 | anchor: A81
Do not park in an intersection. [A81]
Source: [A81 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0081]

FACT_ID: sec10-F07 | anchor: A81
Do not park within fifty feet of railroad tracks. [A81]
Source: [A81 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0081]

FACT_ID: sec10-F08 | anchor: A81
Parking on a bridge or overpass is prohibited. [A81]
Source: [A81 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0081]

FACT_ID: sec10-F09 | anchor: A81
Do not park in front of a driveway. [A81]
Source: [A81 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0081]

FACT_ID: sec10-F10 | anchor: A81
Leave at least the prohibited fifteen-foot area around a fire hydrant free of parked vehicles. [A81]
Source: [A81 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0081]

FACT_ID: sec10-F11 | anchor: A81
Do not park within twenty feet of a crosswalk. [A81]
Source: [A81 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0081]

FACT_ID: sec10-F12 | anchor: A81
Parking is barred within thirty feet of a stop sign, yield sign or traffic signal. [A81]
Source: [A81 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0081]

FACT_ID: sec10-F13 | anchor: A81
Keep parked vehicles out of the twenty-foot area by a fire-station driveway. [A81]
Source: [A81 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0081]

FACT_ID: sec10-F14 | anchor: A81
Do not park on a controlled-access highway, including a freeway. [A81]
Source: [A81 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0081]

FACT_ID: sec10-F15 | anchor: A81
A prohibitory parking sign or red-painted curb means parking is not allowed there. [A81]
Source: [A81 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0081]

FACT_ID: sec10-F16 | anchor: A82
Disability-reserved parking requires the described disability symbol on the vehicle's plate or special card; drivers without the qualifying disability may not use those spaces and can be fined. [A82]
Source: [A82 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0082]

FACT_ID: sec10-F17 | anchor: A82
The handbook permits a person with a disability to park a symbol-displaying automobile in a reserved disability space without payment or a time limit. [A82]
Source: [A82 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0082]

FACT_ID: sec10-F18 | anchor: A82
Before getting into a vehicle that will be backed, inspect behind it because small children and objects may be hidden from the driver's seat. [A82]
Source: [A82 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0082]

FACT_ID: sec10-F19 | anchor: A82
When backing, rest the right arm behind the passenger seat and look back over the shoulder through the rear window rather than relying on mirrors. [A82]
Source: [A82 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0082]

FACT_ID: sec10-F20 | anchor: A82
Reverse slowly and continue looking behind until the vehicle has completely stopped. [A82]
Source: [A82 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0082]

FACT_ID: sec10-F21 | anchor: A82
Avoid reversing in traffic whenever possible. [A82]
Source: [A82 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0082]

FACT_ID: sec10-F22 | anchor: A82
After missing an interstate exit, continue to the next exit; do not reverse or attempt to turn around. [A82]
Source: [A82 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0082]

FACT_ID: sec10-F23 | anchor: A82
Reversing is prohibited on freeways, expressways and other controlled-access roads, including their shoulders. [A82]
Source: [A82 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0082]

FACT_ID: sec10-F24 | anchor: A82
Away from controlled-access roads, reverse only when it is safe and does not interfere with traffic. [A82]
Source: [A82 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0082]

FACT_ID: sec10-F25 | anchor: A83
Guard against boredom and fatigue while driving on a freeway. [A83]
Source: [A83 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0083]

FACT_ID: sec10-F26 | anchor: A83
The handbook allows up to eighty miles an hour on rural interstates and sixty-five on urban interstates only where designated, weather permits and no different speed is posted. [A83]
Source: [A83 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0083]

FACT_ID: sec10-F27 | anchor: A83
A usual freeway entrance consists of a ramp, an acceleration lane and a merging area. [A83]
Source: [A83 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0083]

FACT_ID: sec10-F28 | anchor: A83
Use the entrance ramp to observe freeway traffic before reaching the acceleration lane. [A83]
Source: [A83 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0083]

FACT_ID: sec10-F29 | anchor: A83
In the acceleration lane, build speed to match freeway traffic; use the merging area to join the freeway's outside lane. [A83]
Source: [A83 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0083]

Misconceptions: A missed freeway entrance or exit is corrected at a later exit; it does not permit reversing or a median turn. The highest stated interstate speed is conditional.
Mnemonic: Plan, observe, signal and blend is a teaching reminder for source-supported entrance actions.
Glossary: Double parking occupies the street side of a parked vehicle; an acceleration lane allows speed adjustment; a merging area joins freeway traffic.
Dynamic facts: installed speed and parking controls, weather and present traffic openings determine actual driving choices.
